ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the medial and lower portions of both lobes. A continuous low-intensity black band defines the trailing edge. Numerous small-to-medium black circular spots and irregular mottling are distributed throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, showing increased jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly downward-pointing distal edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct spatial clusters of circular black rings (rosettes) are visible, particularly concentrated in the central-medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters (barnacles) with high-intensity, textured pixel signatures are located at the distal tips of both lobes. Extensive circular scarring patterns are visible across the central white surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'double-ring' or 'figure-eight' pigmentation pattern located in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
